meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of configure.

sentences.en: With the router properly configured, you have to make sure that both computers are set to Obtain an IP address automatically.

sentences.en: Weighing in at just 39kg this fully specified anvil for the mobile farrier is configured for precise and efficient forging.
